tree_single.notes: One-column tree, top then rooted lower half.

tree_pair.notes: Dense two-column, two-row tree cluster; row 5 contains separate fallen logs.

tree_pair_middle.notes: Middle two-column canopy variant from the connected tree block.

tree_pair_right.notes: Right two-column canopy variant from the connected tree block.

tree_lobe_left.notes: Three-by-two left canopy lobe used to vary forest silhouettes.

tree_lobe_right.notes: Three-by-two right canopy lobe used to vary forest silhouettes.

cave_mouth.notes: Two-cell cave opening designed to replace the center of a cliff face.

bridge_horizontal.notes: Five-cell deck with the supplied diagonal and center supports beneath.

bridge_vertical_standard.notes: Vertical bridge: top, two middle deck cells, and lower landing.

path_landing_north.notes: Supplied contiguous five-by-two cobblestone taper for a north-side landing.

path_landing_south.notes: Supplied contiguous five-by-two cobblestone taper for a south-side landing.

intentionalOmissions.campfire: No static campfire was confirmed in the six allowed source sheets; the demonstration uses the separate flame animation. The final map therefore uses an abandoned/extinguished camp instead of guessing or importing an eighth asset.
